project.name: Memory Layer Pro
project.objective: Educational GPT-style memory application (Memory Lab MVP): chat system that keeps recent working context, retrieves durable memories for a new question, uses one hosted Nemotron model call per turn for both answer and memory proposals, validates proposals in Python, and exposes each stage in a UI trace. Streamlit + PostgreSQL/pgvector + Redis + local embeddings, synthetic demo data only.

decisions.title: Every finished task is pushed to GitHub
decisions.text: Per-task workflow: run gates, commit, push to memory-layer-pro remote after each completed task. Blocked until gh auth login completes.

decisions.title: ADR.md is the specification source
decisions.text: SPEC.md FR/NFR/AC derived from ADR.md Memory Lab MVP brief; ADR remains the reference.

decisions.title: NVIDIA key validated live
decisions.text: nvidia_api_key in .env lists 85 hosted models including 20 Nemotron; live smoke deferred to implementation, mocks stay for automated checks.

decisions.title: Default embedding model fixed
decisions.text: bge-small-en class, 384-dim vectors; pgvector column sized accordingly.

decisions.title: Docker is deploy-time, not build-time
decisions.text: Postgres+pgvector and Redis may run natively on the Mac for build/test; Docker packaging happens at the end.

knowledge.title: 70b-instruct not entitled; lightning-30b works
knowledge.text: nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-70b-instruct returns 404 Function-not-found on this key; nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b completes and parses. Prefer lightning-30b for smoke tests.
